purpose: Manual and automated dogfooding cases required before Specship is considered for public release.

cases.name: Precise one-file bug
cases.expectation: $spec asks no ceremonial questions, seals a bounded full plan, and never implements the fix.

cases.name: Material clarification
cases.expectation: The blocking question is recorded before pausing and seal refuses the plan until it is resolved or explicitly assumed.

cases.name: Multi-layer migration
cases.expectation: Requirements cover compatibility, rollout, rollback, and validation; tasks remain executable as one complete bounded plan.

cases.name: Stale plan after repository change
cases.expectation: $ship start rejects a changed HEAD or dirty-file set and returns the plan to $spec refine.

cases.name: Execution blocker
cases.expectation: $ship appends evidence and changes only STATE.md and RESULTS.md; $spec owns the resulting contract revision.

cases.name: Failed review
cases.expectation: $spec appends a revision-pinned review, starts a new revision, adds corrective tasks, and reseals without implementing them.

cases.name: Passing review with delayed confirmation
cases.expectation: The plan stops at ReadyForConfirmation and canonical project docs remain untouched until explicit finalize authorization.

cases.name: Dirty worktree with unrelated changes
cases.expectation: The planning baseline records dirty paths and $ship preserves them; any changed dirty-file set blocks start.

cases.name: Refinement after partial implementation
cases.expectation: A new contract revision invalidates prior completion state and evidence cannot satisfy the new digest.

cases.name: Interrupted full-plan execution
cases.expectation: A new $ship conversation resumes the same InProgress plan from STATE.md without repeating Done tasks or switching to single-task mode.
